mechanism: Build a closed cluster of up to 8 currencies (USD,EUR,GBP,CHF,JPY,CAD,AUD,NZD) from dollar crosses (synthetic non-USD crosses). For each bar’s filtered price change of a pair, add Δ to base currency and subtract Δ from quote (percent in CCFp to avoid point heaviness). Sum of currencies = 0 (balance line). Above zero = overbought vs peers; below = oversold; near zero = balanced. CCFp blends multiple TFs for trend; CC is impulse; Complex_Pair1 = EUR+USD (or pair legs) as one signal line.

mechanism: Alternative Ichimoku: SSP shifts the priority cloud line; SSK shifts the overdue line; inner stop-order line = f(SSP). Price outside cloud ⇒ trend; exit from cloud ⇒ trend change; break of stop-order line ⇒ high turn probability. Tune SSP so High/Low (or Close) touch stop-order/priority as S/R on both up and down swings; tune SSK so overdue line acts as secondary S/R in mixed regimes. Classic Ichimoku cloud inside=non-trend, above/below=support/resistance stack also reviewed.
data_needed: OHLC on chart TF; SSP, SSK parameters; Alternative Ichimoku indicator (codebase 7070).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Current currency pair chart examples (setup via touches on sharp pivots); applicable to standard Ichimoku too

quote: The position of the currency outside the cloud is a certain sign of a trend existence. … The exit of currencies from the cloud signals about a trend change. … When the stop-order line is broken through, the probability of trend turn is very high.
